description: This Java source file defines the CareSetting class, which models the scope of care in the medical record system. It includes properties for care setting ID, type (outpatient or inpatient), and constructors for initialization, along with getter and setter methods. The class is annotated for auditing and using Hibernate, and extends a base metadata class.

classes.name: CareSetting
classes.description: Represents a scope of care within a medical setting, such as outpatient or inpatient, with properties for ID, type, name, and description, extending a metadata base class.

methods.name: CareSetting()
methods.description: Default constructor for the CareSetting class.

methods.name: CareSetting(String name, String description, CareSettingType careSettingType)
methods.description: Constructs a CareSetting with specified name, description, and type.

methods.name: getCareSettingId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the care setting.

methods.name: setCareSettingId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the care setting.

methods.name: getCareSettingType
methods.description: Returns the type of care setting, either OUTPATIENT or INPATIENT.

methods.name: setCareSettingType
methods.description: Sets the type of care setting.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the base method to return the care setting ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set the care setting ID.
